newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends down, trade lifts from lows.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends down, trade lifts from lows.

text.p: CSCE March world sugar futures closed barely weaker in heavy trade focused on speculative liquation and options activity ahead of Friday's March expiry, market sources said.
Spot March settled 0.02 cent weaker at 10.64 cents a pound after trading from 10.73 to 10.53 cents. The outer months ended down 0.03 and 0.04.
Early buying from Far Eastern trade houses and local buying attempting to probe stops between 10.73 and 10.75 cents, carried prices to the day's highs.
Options-related selling capped the rally and prompted speculators to get out of long positions, pressuring the market to the lows, a broker said.
The March contract held above support seen at 10.50 cents. Buying in the March/May spread lifted prices to unchanged where the market lingered through the close.
The March/May spread closed at 0.03 compared with 0.01 cent Wednesday.
Open interest in March stood at 45,526 lots, down 4,493 lots from the previous close.
Open interest in May rose 1,847 lots to 41,006 lots. ((Suzanne Rostler, New York Commodity Desk 212-859-1640))
